text:
A farmer incorrectly adds two substances to the soil at the same time.
They react together to form a gas which turns damp red litmus paper blue.
What are the two substances?
A
a basic oxide and a potassium salt
B
a basic oxide and an ammonium salt
C
an acidic oxide and a potassium salt
D
an acidic oxide and an ammonium salt

options.label: A
options.text: a basic oxide and a potassium salt

options.label: B
options.text: a basic oxide and an ammonium salt

options.label: C
options.text: an acidic oxide and a potassium salt

options.label: D
options.text: an acidic oxide and an ammonium salt
